channel.title: Wyatt's Notes — Python
channel.description: Python programming from basics to advanced patterns.

item.title: Types and Variables
item.description: Python's type system, dynamic vs static typing, mutable vs immutable types, variable assignment, and type checking. Comprehensive coverage with definitions and practice problems.

item.title: Control Flow
item.description: Conditional statements, loops, comprehensions, and control flow structures in Python. if/elif/else, for/while loops, and pattern matching.

item.title: Functions
item.description: Function definitions, arguments, return values, decorators, closures, and functional programming concepts in Python.

item.title: Generators and Iterators
item.description: Generator functions, iterator protocol, yield expressions, and lazy evaluation patterns for memory-efficient Python programming.

item.title: Python Internals
item.description: CPython interpreter internals, bytecode compilation, the GIL, reference counting, and memory management in Python.

item.title: Modules and Packages
item.description: Import system, module search path, package structure, namespace packages, and creating reusable Python packages.

item.title: Collections Module
item.description: Python collections module: namedtuple, deque, defaultdict, OrderedDict, and Counter for specialised data structure operations.

item.title: Dictionaries, Sets, and Counter
item.description: Dictionary implementations, set operations, Counter for counting hashable objects, and performance characteristics of Python data structures.

item.title: Classes and OOP
item.description: Class definitions, instance methods, class methods, static methods, inheritance, and composition in Python object-oriented programming.

item.title: Metaclasses
item.description: Type as a metaclass, __new__ vs __init__, metaclass syntax, and practical applications of metaclasses in Python framework design.

item.title: Descriptors
item.description: Descriptor protocol, __get__, __set__, __delete__, and how Python uses descriptors for properties, methods, and class attributes.

item.title: Essential Standard Library Modules
item.description: Must-know Python standard library modules: os, sys, pathlib, collections, itertools, functools, and typing for production code.

item.title: Async Await
item.description: Python async/await syntax, coroutines, event loops, asyncio library, and asynchronous programming patterns for I/O-bound tasks.

item.title: Style and Idioms
item.description: PEP 8 style guide, Pythonic idioms, list comprehensions vs generator expressions, and writing clean, readable Python code.

item.title: Python Programming — Complete Guide
item.description: 30 pages of Python programming notes covering fundamentals, data structures, OOP, standard library, async programming, and best practices.
